british-antarctic-territory.title: Flag of the British Antarctic Territory

colors.note: British ensign tradition and the Southern Ocean.

desc:
- A British White Ensign (later Blue Ensign) defaced with the territory's coat of arms, which features a flaming torch on a shield supported by the ship HMS Endurance and a lion
- Adopted on 21 March 1963 when the territory was separated from the Falkland Islands Dependencies
- The territory covers the Antarctic Peninsula and surrounding islands claimed by Britain
- **Construction:** British Blue Ensign with the coat of arms on a white disc in the fly half. Ratio 1:2
trivia:
- This Antarctic territory includes several islands used primarily for scientific research
- The Union Jack reflects British sovereignty over the region
- Few permanent residents; used mainly for scientific bases
